reference.citation: Fukuchi CA, Fukuchi RK, Duarte M (2018), PeerJ 6:e4640 (WBDS, figshare 5722711, CC-BY 4.0); function-on-scalar (functional) regression. 42 subjects x 8 treadmill speeds, sagittal knee angle.
reference.description: function-on-scalar regression of the within-subject-centred WBDS knee curves on speed reproduces the case EXACTLY: the coefficient peaks at 65% cycle at +3.341 deg/level, curve-wide permutation p=5e-4, pooled peak-flexion-vs-speed r=0.627, over 328 curves
